page_title: BAY 7-0 BOC | Bayern Munich v Bochum 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Robert Hartmann sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
89' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bayern Munich players aren’t happy.
88' 7 - 0 Goal - 7:0! Noussair Mazraoui laid the ball off to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
87' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball heads into the top left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
86' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tries to find Cristian Gamboa, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
86' The attendance for today's match is 75000.

84' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Sven Ulreich pulls off an easy save.

81' 6 - 0 Harry Kane passes to Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes inside the right post. Fabulous goal! The score is 6:0.
81' Noah Loosli (Bochum) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
80' 13:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
77' Here comes a substitution. Christopher Antwi-Adjei is given a rest as he is replaced by Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
77' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Kingsley Coman will be replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
77' Substitution. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) replaces Joshua Kimmich.
77' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
75' Some neat passing and movement from Bayern Munich as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

71' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Manuel Riemann allowed him to make a comfortable save.
70' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
69' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

69' Frans Kratzig (Bayern Munich) latched on to an accurate pass just outside the box and immediately lashed the ball towards the top left corner. His effort was thwarted by Manuel Riemann, who pulled off a stunning save. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
68' Today's match ends for Takuma Asano who will be replaced by Patrick Osterhage (Bochum).
65' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Frans Kratzig (Bayern Munich) replacing Alphonso Davies.
65' Substitution. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
65' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) plants a goal-bound header towards the left post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.

64' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
64' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take a corner kick.
64' The ball is cleared after Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle and it's Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
59' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
59' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
58' Pass and go! That was a trademark one-two pass between Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) and Leroy Sane.

57' A neat pass is well received by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
56' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to find Leroy Sane, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
54' 5 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Riemann into left side of the goal.
54' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
53' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) handles the ball inside the box. Bayern Munich are given a penalty!
51' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
50' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

47' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
47' The referee awards a corner and Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.
46' The game is over for Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich). Dayot Upamecano comes on for the second half.
46' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Cristian Gamboa comes on the pitch for Anthony Losilla (Bochum).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Lovely run from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
45+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45+1' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' The free kick from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.

44' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Bochum are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
43' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
41' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

40' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
38' 4 - 0 Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Harry Kane. He takes the shot early and scores!
37' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross from the corner, but Manuel Riemann reads it well and gathers the ball.

36' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
36' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) replaces Maximilian Wittek.
36' Substitution. Felix Passlack makes his way off the pitch and Noah Loosli (Bochum) comes on as his replacement.

36' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Manuel Riemann makes a great save to stop his effort. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
32' The corner from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is intercepted by the defence.
30' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

29' 3 - 0 A perfectly taken corner kick. Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the left post, increasing the score of today's match – 3:0.
28' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will deliver the corner kick.

28' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
26' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Anthony Losilla (Bochum) for his blatant foul.
26' It could have been a good chance to score! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fails to release Kingsley Coman with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
24' Sven Ulreich (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
24' Sven Ulreich (Bayern Munich) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sven Ulreich, who smothers the ball.
21' This shall not pass! Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
21' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

20' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
19' A lofted cross from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
19' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
17' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Riemann intercepts the ball.

15' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
13' 2 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
11' Bernardo (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.

9' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
9' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
8' An attempted cross from Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
8' Direct free kick. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
8' Referee Robert Hartmann sees the trip by Bernardo (Bochum) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Bayern Munich.

4' 1 - 0 Goal! Kingsley Coman produces a great pass that finds Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
3' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
2' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
1' Manuel Riemann makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) after a cross from the side.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Robert Hartmann will supervise the game today.
